tasks.commitBody: The app's first upload path: a librarian attaches one or several files to an edition. Two-step Entu mechanism built to the platform docs (consult-and-believe): append-POST of file metadata to the edition (several files per POST, each returning its own signed upload object), then a direct S3 PUT carrying exactly the four returned headers — through an injected fetch seam, never the Entu-scoped client. The phantom-attachment rider is closed per the docs' own recovery instruction: a failed or interrupted PUT deletes the just-created file property (user-facing at _editor tier — the stale admin-only memory was corrected against the current docs tonight) and fails visibly per file; partial batches state exactly what landed. Download URLs are minted at click time via the existing 60s-TTL seam — nothing caches a signed URL. The files list is a new render path (edition.files rendered nowhere before); the agenda's PDF-link path is untouched. STATED CHOICES: <GREEN agent fills the six stated choices as sentences>. Live gates: Mihkel's copy pass (all strings drafted); his layout read at phone width; a manual live-smoke upload on polyphony (the S3 leg is untestable in vitest by design — flagged, not hidden).
